description: This file defines the LayerNode class, which extends PcbNode. It represents a layer in a PCB design, with methods to retrieve its name and determine if it is a silk screen layer.

classes.name: LayerNode
classes.description: Represents a PCB layer node with a name and methods to identify silk screen layers.

methods.name: LayerNode
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the LayerNode with a name, closing index, and children nodes.

methods.name: isSikscreenLayer
methods.description: Determines if this layer is a silk screen layer based on its name.
